autoPay.title: Automatic charging
autoPay.intro: Fees and instalments are charged to a customer's saved card only when they agreed at checkout. Failed charges stay unpaid and the customer is emailed.
autoPay.autoFees: Charge late-cancellation and no-show fees automatically
autoPay.delay: Waive window before a fee is charged
autoPay.autoInstalments: Charge sports instalments on their due date
